text:
maria: Quick design review — thinking of a subtle banner above the schema editor when 'Param Suggest' is on to explain what it does + show the keyboard shortcut. Thoughts?
aj: Love it. Two accessibility asks: (1) dismissible via keyboard (Esc), (2) screenreader should announce it as an informative region, not a dialog.
sam k: Keep the banner short. One sentence + 'Learn more' link to docs. Engineers prefer terse.
lina: Agree. Use ARIA role="status" so NVDA/VoiceOver speak it immediately; avoid focus trap.
maria: Draft copy: "Param Suggest helps prefill function args from conversation context. Toggle it with Ctrl+Option+P — learn more." Too wordy?
aj: Shorten to: "Param Suggest auto-fills args from recent messages. Toggle: ⌘⇧P (Mac) / Ctrl+Shift+P (Win)." Also include visually hidden text indicating it's non-modal.
sam k: Detect platform and render proper shortcut. Also add a tiny pin icon to let users keep the banner visible after dismissing.
lina: Pinned state needs accessible name: "Keep Param Suggest banner visible" and `aria-pressed` updates.
maria: For prototype, persist dismiss in localStorage; product wants account-level setting later.
aj: Agreed. Add telemetry events: banner_shown, banner_dismissed, banner_pinned. No PII.
sam k: In run history, surface whether Param Suggest was applied for each invocation. Maybe a small pill: "PS:on" / "PS:off" next to run time. Designers?
lina: Pill must meet color-contrast and have a tooltip for assistive tech: e.g. aria-label="Param Suggest enabled for this run".
maria: Tooltip copy: "Param Suggest was applied to autofill function arguments for this run."
aj: Edge case: if Param Suggest autofill caused incorrect args, add a one-click "Revert suggestions" action in the run inspector callstack.
sam k: Dev note: add a 1px dashed border around the revert action so it's visually distinct.
lina: Accessibility nit: ensure revert is keyboard-focusable and announced as a button with `aria-label="Revert parameter suggestions"`.
maria: I'll update Figma with banner variants, pin states, pill, and revert action plus a short a11y checklist. Ping when prototypes are up; I'll run a keyboard walkthrough. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Deploy preview ready: https://redwood-inference.internal/proto/param-suggest-banner (expires in 48h)
aj: I'll test on VoiceOver and NVDA later and post results here. Thanks all!
